verdict.rationale: SAM.gov has its own credential model: keys are tied to accounts, a separate approved System Account can be created for machine access, and data access is tiered (Public, FOUO, Sensitive) by the account's sensitivity level. That gives a coarse form of least privilege for an agent identity. However, nothing shows fine-grained scopes being chosen per key at issuance time. Missing for 10: per-key scope selection, per-endpoint or read-only permission controls, self-service issuance of multiple restricted keys, key expiry/rotation controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
